lines.text: Many learners say: What art of music do you like?
Better: What kind of music do you like?
Say kind of, not art of.
Kind! What kind of food do you like?

data.wrong: What art of music do you like?
data.right: What kind of music do you like?
data.why: Say kind of, not art of.

quiz.stem: What ___ of food do you like?

native.tip: „Welche Art von Musik“ sagst du auf Englisch mit „kind of“. „Art“ ist Kunst.

native.comment: Lösung: “kind”. Richtig heißt es: “What kind of music do you like?” Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.hook: Are you asking about the Art of music?
en.tip: For “Art von” say “kind of”. “Art” means Kunst.
